scripts.text:
[King of Prontera]
Hello, can you help me?
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉国王]
你好，能帮个忙吗？

scripts.text: Sure, what can I do?
scripts.translation: 当然，需要做什么？

scripts.text: Sorry, I'm busy.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我很忙。

scripts.text:
[King of Prontera]
Ok, that's fine, I'm sure someone else will help.
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉国王]
好的，没关系，我相信会有其他人帮忙的。

scripts.text:
[King of Prontera]
Thank you. Well, my daughter next to me is a little rowdy...
If you get her these items I'm sure she'll calm down.
I'll give you my crown or my sword as a reward.
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉国王]
谢谢。嗯，我旁边的女儿有点调皮...
如果你能给她这些物品，我相信她会安静下来的。
我会把我的王冠或剑作为奖励给你。

scripts.text: What do you need?
scripts.translation: 你需要什么？

scripts.text: I have the items!
scripts.translation: 我有这些物品！

scripts.text: Forget it.
scripts.translation: 算了。

scripts.text:
[King of Prontera]
What item do you want?
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉国王]
你想要哪个物品？

scripts.text: Crown
scripts.translation: 王冠

scripts.text: Sword
scripts.translation: 剑

scripts.text:
[King of Prontera]
You're missing something.
Come back after you get ALL the items.
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉国王]
你还缺一些东西。
集齐所有物品后再回来吧。

scripts.text:
[King of Prontera]
THANK YOU SOO MUCH!!
This will surely calm her down.
As promised, here is my {0}
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉国王]
非常感谢你！！
这肯定能让她安静下来。
如我所承诺，这是给你的{0}

scripts.text:
[King of Prontera]
Ok, that's fine, I'm sure someone else will help.
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉国王]
好的，没关系，我相信会有其他人帮忙的。

scripts.text:
[King's Daughter]
Hmph, I hate my dad right now!!
scripts.translation:
[国王的女儿]
哼，我现在讨厌我爸爸！！

scripts.text: Why?
scripts.translation: 为什么？

scripts.text: Whatever...
scripts.translation: 随便吧...

scripts.text:
[King's Daughter]
FINE THEN! Hmph!!
scripts.translation:
[国王的女儿]
好吧！哼！！

scripts.text:
[King's Daughter]
Well, he won't give me what I want!!
He's the King of Prontera. He should be able to get me ANYTHING!!!
scripts.translation:
[国王的女儿]
哼，他就不给我想要的东西！！
他是普隆德拉的国王。他应该能给我任何东西！！！
